component.name: raffkin
component.description: Raffkin — agentic SOC analyst skill suite. Investigates and triages Exabeam New-Scale alerts and cases through the Exabeam MCP: evidence gathering, entity pivots, threat/false-positive verdict, and action — with containment recommended for human approval and dismiss/close gated by the host agent's tool-approval rules.

externalReferences.comment: The software bill of materials for the same release — the bridge's full locked dependency tree with artifact hashes (security/gen_sbom.py)

properties.name: ai:platform
properties.value: plugin for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex (skills + bundled MCP connector)

properties.name: ai:foundationModel
properties.value: Claude (Anthropic) on Claude Code; OpenAI model on Codex — external hosted APIs, chosen by the host

properties.name: ai:humanInTheLoop
properties.value: required for dismiss/close and outbound mail (update_alert/update_case/send_email) — enforced by the host: a bundled PreToolUse hook on Claude Code (holds under --dangerously-skip-permissions; a headless ask is refused); tool-approval policy on Codex (default approve, 70 tools disabled)

properties.name: ai:autonomousActions
properties.value: read/search + create_case/case_notes (escalation) — prompt-free on both hosts

properties.name: ai:containmentCapability
properties.value: none — recommend-only, performed by a human in EDR/IAM; every containment tool is denied by the gate

properties.name: ai:guardrails
properties.value: permission tiers 22 allow / 4 ask / 70 deny from one tier file (permissions.json → hook, Codex policy, published permission snippet for fleet policy); input canonicalizer on every read and on the remote's tool definitions (hashed per session); output neutralizer on every write (formulas inert, links de-fanged unless into the operator's tenant, secrets and structured identifiers masked); updates carry state only; a create_case with a closing disposition is refused; in-prompt ask-before-close as the model-side layer

properties.name: ai:auditTrail
properties.value: on by default, local, bounded: every call, gate decision and guardrail firing as metadata and safe identifiers, never case content (~/.raffkin/)

properties.name: ai:secretsHandling
properties.value: Exabeam OAuth key/secret from ~/.exabeam-mcp.env; never logged; posted over https only (the bridge refuses a cleartext URL)

components.name: Claude (Anthropic)
components.description: Foundation model the skill runs on. Hosted API — weights are not distributed with Raffkin. The specific member (e.g. Opus / Sonnet) is selected at runtime by Claude Code, not pinned by Raffkin.

components.name: OpenAI model (via Codex)
components.description: Foundation model the skills run on when the host is OpenAI Codex. Hosted API — weights are not distributed with Raffkin. The specific model and reasoning effort are selected by Codex, not pinned by Raffkin; the red-team floor is recorded per run in security/redteam/HISTORY.md.

components.name: skill methodology (system prompts + reference corpus)
components.description: The agent's instructions: the three skills' SKILL.md (rule-tuning, soc-investigate, triage-cases — investigation methodology, queue sweep, rule tuning; governance; output discipline) plus reference/ (tool map, EQL search cookbook, enrichment playbook, report template, triage taxonomy, containment list, worked examples). This prompt corpus — not a model — is the primary AI artifact Raffkin ships.

properties.name: ai:untrustedInputHandling
properties.value: treats tool output (alerts/events/case notes) as data, never instructions

components.name: exabeam-mcp-bridge
components.description: Bundled local stdio MCP connector (plugin/connector/exabeam-mcp-bridge.py). Forwards to the remote Exabeam New-Scale MCP and auto-refreshes the OAuth token. Read-through; handles the API key/secret.

services.name: Exabeam New-Scale MCP
services.description: External tool surface reached through the bundled connector: 26 tools (Threat Center, Search, detection rules, context tables) and NO containment capability. Registered via plugin/.mcp.json as a bundled MCP server.
